steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "5.36 | PATCH | Ensure 'Windows Mobile Hotspot Service (icssvc)' is set to 'Disabled'"
  when: win11cis_rule_5_36
  tags:
    - level1-corporate-enterprise-environment
    - patch
    - automated
    - rule_5.36
    - icssvc
  block:
    - name: "5.36 | AUDIT | Ensure 'Windows Mobile Hotspot Service (icssvc)' is set to 'Disabled' | Check to see if icssvc service exists"
      ansible.windows.win_service_info:
        name: icssvc
      register: discovered_5_36_icssvc_service_info

    - name: "5.36 | PATCH | Ensure 'Windows Mobile Hotspot Service (icssvc)' is set to 'Disabled' | Disable icssvc service"
      when: discovered_5_36_icssvc_service_info.exists
      ansible.windows.win_service:
        name: icssvc
        start_mode: disabled
        state: stopped
